entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: A sun-associated being whose adherents bask in its light and expel darkness.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: A moon-associated being whose presence turned day to night and neighbors against one another.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane of kithkin, merrow, elves, giants and faeries, balanced against Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: A chaotic counterpart to Lorwyn where wilds and shadow creatures dominate.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: A people of Lorwyn bound mind to mind through the thoughtweft.

entities.name: the thoughtweft
entities.description: A mental bond linking kithkin that amplifies courage and fear.

entities.name: Merrow
entities.description: A water-dwelling people of Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Rimekin
entities.description: Once flamekin who turned their heat inward after the Invasion.

entities.name: Flamekin
entities.description: A fiery people who walk the Path of Flame.

entities.name: the Invasion
entities.description: A horror that scarred Lorwyn and changed its peoples.

entities.name: Mount Tanufel
entities.description: A mountain guarded by rimekin.

entities.name: Mount Kulrath
entities.description: A volcanic mountain whose slopes the flamekin know.

entities.name: Dark Meanders
entities.description: A silent, refuse-filled place where many become lost.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: A fae ascendant who declares herself Queen of her domain.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: A former fae ruler preceding Maralen.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: A figure whose game made Kirol a pawn.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A first-year who hated being a pawn in Morcant's game.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A Strixhaven first-year.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: A school whose first-year students include Tam.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A student whose mind turned from panic to poetry.

entities.name: Auntie Grub
entities.description: A boggart auntie whose tales feature Trugg.

entities.name: Trugg
entities.description: A berserker ready to appear in Auntie Grub's tales.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A flamekin who speaks of fire and water united.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: A merrow guide to the Dark Meanders.

entities.name: Trystan
entities.description: An elf who speaks of grief and anger.

entities.name: Brigid
entities.description: A kithkin who warns children not to venture past the walls.

entities.name: Yenn
entities.description: A kithkin nomad who saw yellow eyes.

entities.name: Edren
entities.description: A kithkin farmer.

entities.name: Toch
entities.description: A Ballynock sage.

entities.name: Ballynock
entities.description: A place of which Toch is a sage.

entities.name: Moon-Vigil Adherents
entities.description: Adherents of the moon seeking to bring the plane under Isilu's domain.

entities.name: Clan Boldwyr
entities.description: A giant clan that defended its dolmens during the Invasion.

entities.name: Doran
entities.description: A speaker who warns the world is cruel.

events.summary: A man wished for isolation and Shadowmoor answered.
events.quote: He wished for isolation, and Shadowmoor replied.

events.summary: Isilu's presence turned day to night and neighbors against one another.
events.quote: Isilu's presence turned day to night, fellowship to suspicion, and neighbors against one another.

events.summary: Isilu drifted past and the half-buried stones began to wake.
events.quote: As Isilu drifted past in a swirl of shadow and moonlight, the strange, half-buried stones began to wake.

events.summary: Clan Boldwyr defended its dolmens legendarily during the Invasion.
events.quote: During the Invasion, Clan Boldwyr's defense of their dolmens was legendary.

events.summary: Flamekin turned their heat inward after the Invasion and became rimekin.
events.quote: Rimekin were once flamekin who turned their heat inward following the horrors of the Invasion.

events.summary: Maralen succeeded Oona as ruler of the fae.
events.quote: Maralen is more forgiving than Oona was, but her rule is no less absolute.

events.summary: Maralen declared herself Queen of her domain.
